triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER clan_elder_title_release_delete_v1 AFTER DELETE ON public.app_meta DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.key = 'clan_resumption_v1'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_clan_elder_title_role_changed_v1()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER clan_elder_title_release_insert_v1 AFTER INSERT ON public.app_meta DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((new.key = 'clan_resumption_v1'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_clan_elder_title_role_changed_v1()

CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER clan_elder_title_release_update_v1 AFTER UPDATE OF key, value ON public.app_meta DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((((old.key = 'clan_resumption_v1'::text) OR (new.key = 'clan_resumption_v1'::text)) AND ((old.key IS DISTINCT FROM new.key) OR (old.value IS DISTINCT FROM new.value)))) EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_clan_elder_title_role_changed_v1()
CREATE TRIGGER cnine_sync_delete_v1 AFTER DELETE ON public.app_meta REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_account_sync_stamp_v1('key', 'meta')

CREATE TRIGGER cnine_sync_update_v1 AFTER UPDATE ON public.app_meta REFERENCING OLD TABLE AS old_rows NEW TABLE AS new_rows FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cnine_account_sync_stamp_v1('key', 'meta')
